quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a city-wide low-frequency hum that is felt through the ground and building surfaces.
quests.explanation: A felt, pervasive low-frequency data hum identifies a cyber city at full operation.
quests.textToSpeak: The constant data hum of the city at night is a frequency you feel as much as hear.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for an owl call with multiple distinct echoes returning from different tree surfaces.
quests.explanation: Multi-echo owl calls between old oaks identify a dense, old-growth forest.
quests.textToSpeak: An owl's call reverberates between the old oaks, each echo subtly different from the last.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a very faint, regular pulse signal emerging from the background of deep-space static.
quests.explanation: A faint probe beacon through background static identifies a spacecraft searching in deep space.
quests.textToSpeak: A rescue beacon from a long-silent probe pulses faintly through the deep-space static.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sequence of precise, largely mechanical sounds from automated laboratory equipment.
quests.explanation: Precise automated sample transfer sounds identify a high-automation research laboratory.
quests.textToSpeak: Precise robotic arms transfer samples with sounds that are almost entirely mechanical.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for timed bursts of encoded data transmission in a monitored communications environment.
quests.explanation: Precisely timed encrypted dispatches identify a military communications operations room.
quests.textToSpeak: Encrypted dispatch orders arrive in bursts of precisely timed coded transmissions.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for creaking and popping sounds from a hull under increasing compressive force.
quests.explanation: Hull creaking under compressive pressure identifies a deep-ocean submersible.
quests.textToSpeak: The pressure hull creaks and pops as the vessel descends toward structural limits.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a brief electronic tone from a pressure pad in an otherwise silent secure space.
quests.explanation: A pressure pad activation tone in silence identifies an underground vault security system.
quests.textToSpeak: A pressure-sensitive floor pad activates silently as unauthorized weight is detected.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the smooth, tonal hum of goods moving efficiently on internal rails.
quests.explanation: Internal rail cargo movement sounds identify an orbital space station logistics system.
quests.textToSpeak: Cargo moves through the station's internal magnetic rail with an almost musical efficiency.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the hushed sounds of parchment being turned in an incense-rich sacred space.
quests.explanation: Parchment sounds in a sandalwood-scented archive identify an ancient temple.
quests.textToSpeak: Sandalwood smoke and the rustle of aged manuscripts fill the temple archive room.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for restrained luxury-brand audio from counter speakers inside a transit departure area.
quests.explanation: Luxury-brand counter audio in a transit departure space identifies an airport duty-free.
quests.textToSpeak: Duty-free counter speakers play soft luxury-brand audio as travelers browse.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the lingering resonance of a steam era in a grand vaulted transit hall.
quests.explanation: Historical resonance and coal smoke in a vaulted hall identify a historical train station.
quests.textToSpeak: Coal smoke lingers in the vaulted station; the historical terminal breathes its own past.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the near-silent and extremely careful handling of ancient documents.
quests.explanation: Near-silent, reverent document handling in an archive identifies a public library.
quests.textToSpeak: Cotton-gloved pages turn with a care that borders on reverence in the archive room.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for youthful group laughter that echoes high off the ceiling of a wide-aisle retail space.
quests.explanation: Echoing teenage laughter in wide retail aisles identifies a shopping mall.
quests.textToSpeak: Teenage laughter echoes off the high ceiling of the wide-aisle shopping mall.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a single specialist voice at very close range delivering an expert opinion.
quests.explanation: A sommelier's close whispered advice at a dining table identifies a luxury restaurant.
quests.textToSpeak: The sommelier whispers a specific vintage recommendation to the diner's ear.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a monotone mower drone that moves gradually across a large open outdoor space.
quests.explanation: A slowly moving mower drone across a large space identifies a city park.
quests.textToSpeak: A distant lawnmower's monotone drone marks the gardener's slow progress across the park.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the rhythmic deep thumping of an MRI scan sequence in a clinical corridor.
quests.explanation: MRI scan thumping in a clinical corridor identifies a modern hospital.
quests.textToSpeak: An MRI machine in the adjacent corridor cycles through its scanning sequence.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the hiss of cooling asphalt and the scrape of leveling tools on a construction site.
quests.explanation: Asphalt steam and concrete leveling sounds identify an active construction site.
quests.textToSpeak: Asphalt steams and fresh concrete hardens as workers move quickly to finish the pour.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for dense insect buzzing in a fruiting tree environment with human harvest activity.
quests.explanation: Pollinator buzzing in fruiting trees during harvest identifies a lush farm orchard.
quests.textToSpeak: The orchard buzzes with pollinators as a late-season harvest begins in the fruit trees.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for score-calling voices on a sand surface as natural light changes.
quests.explanation: Score-calling on sand in changing light identifies a sandy beach volleyball court.
quests.textToSpeak: Volleyball players call scores across the sand court as the sun begins to set.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sudden, single loud crack that echoes across a large open mountain environment.
quests.explanation: A rifle-shot-like ice crack echoing in a mountain bowl identifies a glaciated mountain peak.
quests.textToSpeak: Glacier ice cracks with a rifle-shot sound that echoes across the high bowl.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the soft sound of mist movement combined with nearby concealed animal movement.
quests.explanation: Mist movement and concealed animal sounds identify a forest clearing.
quests.textToSpeak: Mist drifts through a clearing as an unseen animal moves in the undergrowth nearby.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the collective high-frequency pinging of wearable devices in a moving crowd.
quests.explanation: Collective wearable device pinging in a rapidly moving crowd identifies a cyber city district.
quests.textToSpeak: Smartwear devices ping with notifications as commuters move rapidly through the district.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the slow, deep pulse of cryo-cooling cycles during a long spacecraft transit.
quests.explanation: Cryo-chamber cooling cycles during a long transit identify a deep-space vessel.
quests.textToSpeak: Cryo-chambers hum with cooling cycles as the ship traverses the long transit.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for multiple monitors displaying high-speed data with accompanying electronic tones.
quests.explanation: Rapid data cascade on wall monitors identifies a scientific research control centre.
quests.textToSpeak: Data cascades scroll rapidly across the control room's wall-spanning monitor array.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a single wind instrument playing a slow military call as a flag is lowered.
quests.explanation: A lone bugle at flag lowering identifies a military base end-of-day ceremony.
quests.textToSpeak: A lone bugle sounds Taps at dusk as the flag descends to the half-mast position.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the sudden movement of a very large creature through a focused light beam in silence.
quests.explanation: A large creature moving silently through a light beam in darkness identifies the deep ocean.
quests.textToSpeak: A shark moves through the frame of the light beam, silent and impossibly large.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the deliberate sequential clicking of a combination lock in a dark enclosed space.
quests.explanation: Sequential combination lock clicks in darkness identify an underground vault.
quests.textToSpeak: Metallic padlock clicks sequence through a combination in the dark corridor.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a soft monitor chime from sleeping pod systems in a spacecraft.
quests.explanation: Life-monitor chiming from sleeping pods identifies an orbital station crew quarters.
quests.textToSpeak: Crew quarters pods chime softly as a life-monitor registers a change.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the sound of underground water running beneath a stone floor in a sacred space.
quests.explanation: Underground water running beneath a sacred stone floor identifies an ancient temple.
quests.textToSpeak: A sacred spring runs under the altar stone, its gurgle audible in the deepest quiet.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a small rapid automated vehicle accelerating in a large enclosed transit concourse.
quests.explanation: A rapid automated shuttle accelerating in a transit concourse identifies an airport.
quests.textToSpeak: The inter-terminal shuttle accelerates with a mechanical whine across the concourse.
